decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied
Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - 5.	The development hereby permitted is for the summerhouse and shall only be used as a temporary residence for a period of up to 1 year (or such loger period which may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority) from the date of this permission.  After this date has lapsed, the development shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the main dwellinghouse  known as 10 Grove Park Gardens, Chiswick, W4 3RZ.
description: Erection of a single storey detached summerhouse to rear of dwellinghouse which will be used as temporary accommodation for a year while new house on site is under construction
